1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, extreme poverty will end everywhere within a decade. We believe this is within our reach—and we should act now to make sure its benefits reach everyone.

3. We can end extreme poverty everywhere within a decade of building superintelligent AI—and we believe it will be built within the next 20 years. We must prepare now so this breakthrough serves everyone.

**(b) Newsletter opening (106 words)**

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, extreme poverty will end everywhere within a decade. This is not a distant hope; it is a future we can prepare for now. We must make sure the people and communities most affected by poverty share in the benefits of this transformative technology. That means building strong public institutions, widening access to essential services, and ensuring that the tools and resources created by AI reach everyone. We have a clear opportunity before us: a world without extreme poverty, made possible by superintelligent AI. We are committed to turning that possibility into a reality for all.
